Verify whether an email is deliverable (SMTP, MX, catch-all, disposable, role and free checks with a 0-100 quality score) and find business emails from a name + company domain — one at a time or in bulk. Bring your own Verifox API key; get 1,000 free credits at https://verifox.ai/dashboard/api.
